headline: EFCC Recovers 102 Tonnes of Minerals in Illegal Mining Crackdown in Nigeria
summary: Nigeria's Economic and Financial Crimes Commission disclosed 52 illegal mining cases recorded between October 2023 and secured the forfeiture of 102 tonnes of minerals.
why: Enforcement actions against illegal mining operations affect domestic mineral supply chains and regulatory compliance enforcement in resource-rich developing economies.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Crackdowns on illegal mining alter local mineral extraction and export channels.
